observed_features: Small pale cream/light mint rectangular masonry hut under huge spreading trees
Flat low roof with slightly projecting yellow edge and ochre bands/pilasters; shallow horizontal slab canopy above three small square high vents on visible end wall
Narrow barred vertical window on side, small dark doorway on left return
Separate open steel shelter with dark blue corrugated roof at right
Prominent long concrete access ramps with red-brown two-rail tubular handrails; red-grid paving with light-grey/white tactile border
Earth/sand apron and dense tree/coconut background
uncertainties: Hut interior not visible; room subdivisions unresolved

Right low flat-roof bay has large accordion security-gate opening and reddish double wooden door

Grey slab platform paving and low rust-red platform edge

This front elevation is more distinctive than rear/side hut appearance in 2020 ramp photo
